report.summary: Cause: in `public/src/store.js`, the `catch` branch of `load()` set `orders: []` on every failure. So a failed Refresh wiped the list. I removed that line. A failed refresh now keeps the orders on screen and shows "Could not refresh orders.". The next successful load already clears the message. A failed first load still shows "Could not load orders.". Switching filters still clears the old rows before the new list loads, so a list never shows under the wrong filter (ORD-2). I added a regression test in `test/store.test.js`: load, fail a refresh, then succeed on the next refresh. Open question: if a filter change itself fails after the first load, the list is empty and the message is "Could not refresh orders.". The requirements don't cover that case, so I left it as it was.
report.verification: I ran `npm test`. All 5 tests pass, including the new one. I did not drive the browser or stop the server to try the failure by hand.
